artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan removing the Sapience token from the per-project MCP entry: measure mcp.py's config.json fallback, writer+verifier atomic batch, regression test with negative control, token-location documentation, live migration and end-to-end verification.

memory_candidates.content: The live Sapience MCP registration writer is $HOME/.claude/scripts/setup-sapience-mcp.sh -- a user-level copy placed by install-sapience-mcp-session-hook.sh, whose HOOK_SRC/WRITER_SRC resolve relative to the installer's own $SCRIPT_DIR. The SessionStart hook at $HOME/.claude/hooks/ invokes that user-level copy, NOT the per-repo deployed .claude/scripts/ copy. Consequence: a source-store edit to agent-system/extensions/sapience/scripts/setup-sapience-mcp.sh does not reach production via deploy-headless.sh; the installer must be re-run FROM the source store (where $SCRIPT_DIR is the source-store scripts dir) for the edited writer to take effect. A repo redeploy alone changes only the inert deployed copy. This is a general pattern for any extension that installs user-level ($HOME/.claude/) artifacts rather than relying solely on the per-repo deploy tree: such an extension has two propagation paths, and only one of them is deploy-headless.sh.
